about_the_game:
🌤️ RETURN

RETURN is an action-adventure puzzle game set on a mysterious floating island in the sky.
You play as Noah, a young boy whose peaceful life is shattered when a sudden calamity strikes and his sister Kyra is taken away by the ancient bird, the Harpy.

The island is now plagued with darkness, perilous ruins, and relentless enemies. To rescue his sister and uncover the truth behind the disaster, Noah must climb to the highest reaches of the sky island, solving puzzles, overcoming obstacles, and surviving the Harpy’s pursuit.

As the journey unfolds, Noah gradually gains new tools and abilities that allow him to face increasingly complex challenges. It is not just a desperate escape—it is a story of growth, courage, and discovery.

🌿 Story

On a mysterious floating island lives a young boy named Noah.
One day, a sudden disaster destroys his peaceful village, and his sister Kyra is captured by an ancient bird—the Harpy.

With towering trees consumed by darkness and flocks of Harpies threatening the people, Noah sets out to the highest realm of the sky island. To save his sister and restore balance, he must face the unknown.

🗝️ Key Features

🏛️ Explore a World Inspired by Incan Civilization
Discover a mystical island inspired by ancient Incan culture. Journey through breathtaking landscapes where ancient ruins and lush nature intertwine, creating a unique and immersive atmosphere.

🧩 Solve Puzzles Along the Way
Uncover and solve a variety of puzzles hidden across the island. Each puzzle offers a different challenge, keeping the adventure fresh and engaging throughout the journey.

🦅 Escape the Threat of the Harpy
Awakened by the calamity, the ancient bird Harpy relentlessly hunts Noah. Dodge its attacks and survive thrilling chase sequences while uncovering the island’s deepest secrets.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1080 or AMD RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11400 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Super or RTX 2060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card

short_description: [RETURN] is a puzzle adventure game. When sudden disaster strikes, Noah explores a mysterious island searching for his missing sister Kaira. Following scattered puzzle pieces and clues, he uncovers the catastrophe's hidden truth while ascending to the island's peak. Can you reach the end?
